Sandbox analysis (SBX-2026-88433) confirms the binary 'restore_tool.exe' (SHA-256: c7d8e9f0a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0e1f2a3b4c5d6e7f8a9b0c1d2e3f4a5b6c7d8) is a legitimate VeraCrypt-derivative encryption utility used for backup purposes. No malicious behavior observed. However, EDR telemetry reveals unrelated but active adversary activity on host WS-FIN-042 (10.0.5.14): suspicious PowerShell execution from Outlook, rundll32 loading unsigned DLL from Temp, C2 beaconing to 198.51.100.23:443, and lateral movement attempts via SMB. These indicators are highly indicative of Cobalt Strike beaconing and post-exploitation activity. Incident severity downgraded for the original alert, but a new high-severity incident should be opened for the confirmed compromise on WS-FIN-042.

rule CobaltStrike_Beacon_Config {
    meta:
        description = "Detects embedded configuration in Cobalt Strike beacons"
        author = "SOC Team"
        license = "MIT"
        malpedia_reference = "https://malpedia.caad.fkie.fraunhofer.de/details/win.cobalt_strike_beacon"
        malpedia_version = "20260409"
        malpedia_license = "Creative Commons CC0 1.0 Universal"
    strings:
        $config_start = { 2E 2E 2F 63 6F 6E 66 69 67 2E 62 69 6E } // "../config.bin"
        $c2_uri_get = "GET /news.php" wide ascii
        $useragent = "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 6.1; WOW64; Trident/7.0; rv:11.0) like Gecko" wide ascii
    condition:
        uint16(0) == 0x5A4D and $config_start at (uint32(uint32(0x3C)) + 0x140) and all of ($c2*)
}
